title: Stage footwear fit record
passage:
Fitting desk memo | Malvern Stage Footwear

Every dancer at this fitting will bring the socks they normally wear on stage. Some pairs of shoes look the same from the outside but were made on different foot forms. The fitting card must identify the form used for each shoe, not just the overall size. We may swap a left shoe independently of the right one.

If a dancer asks for extra space around the toes, first offer a thinner removable insole. A thinner insole is [139] _____ a larger shoe: it creates room above the foot without changing the length of the shoe.

If the left shoe still feels too short after the change, test the next left shoe length without making another change to the right shoe. [140] _____ The two sides can be ordered with different combinations if this works best for the dancer.

A dancer must try two turns in the trial pair before the assistant submits the order. Until then, mark the fitting as [141] _____ on the card; neither a comfortable first step nor a decision about only one foot is enough to close it.

Orders placed through the desk will be shipped to the theater. Please keep the two combinations on [142] _____ lines on the card, even if the dancer finally selects the same shoe length for both feet. The maker still needs the form and insole choice on each side.
passageZh:
試穿台備忘錄｜馬爾文舞台鞋履

每位來試鞋的舞者都會帶來平時在舞台上穿的襪子。有些鞋外觀相同，但製作時使用的鞋楦不同。試穿卡必須標示每隻鞋使用的鞋楦，不能只記整雙鞋的尺寸。左右兩隻鞋可以各自調換。

若舞者希望腳趾周圍多一些空間，請先提供較薄、可取出的鞋墊。較薄的鞋墊[139] _____大一號的鞋：它增加腳背上方的空間，但不會改變鞋長。

如果換鞋墊後左鞋還是太短，就改試長一個尺寸的左鞋，先不要再改右鞋。[140] _____ 如果這樣最適合舞者，左右鞋可以各用不同的搭配下訂。

舞者必須穿著試穿的鞋做兩次轉身，助理才能送出訂單。在那之前，請在卡上把試穿標為[141] _____；光是第一步舒服，或只確認其中一腳，都不足以結案。

經試穿台下訂的鞋會寄到劇院。即使舞者最後選擇兩腳穿同一鞋長，也請把左右鞋的搭配[142] _____記在試穿卡上。製鞋人員仍需要知道左右腳各用的鞋楦與鞋墊。

Fitting desk memo | Malvern Stage Footwear

Every dancer at this fitting will bring the socks they normally wear on stage. Some pairs of shoes look the same from the outside but were made on different foot forms. The fitting card must identify the form used for each shoe, not just the overall size. We may swap a left shoe independently of the right one.

If a dancer asks for extra space around the toes, first offer a thinner removable insole. A thinner insole is not equivalent to a larger shoe: it creates room above the foot without changing the length of the shoe.

If the left shoe still feels too short after the change, test the next left shoe length without making another change to the right shoe. Enter the form and insole used for the final trial on each side rather than copying the newer left-side entry into both fields. The two sides can be ordered with different combinations if this works best for the dancer.

A dancer must try two turns in the trial pair before the assistant submits the order. Until then, mark the fitting as provisional on the card; neither a comfortable first step nor a decision about only one foot is enough to close it.

Orders placed through the desk will be shipped to the theater. Please keep the two combinations on separate lines on the card, even if the dancer finally selects the same shoe length for both feet. The maker still needs the form and insole choice on each side.

試穿台備忘錄｜馬爾文舞台鞋履

每位來試鞋的舞者都會帶來平時在舞台上穿的襪子。有些鞋外觀相同，但製作時使用的鞋楦不同。試穿卡必須標示每隻鞋使用的鞋楦，不能只記整雙鞋的尺寸。左右兩隻鞋可以各自調換。

若舞者希望腳趾周圍多一些空間，請先提供較薄、可取出的鞋墊。較薄的鞋墊不等同於大一號的鞋：它增加腳背上方的空間，但不會改變鞋長。

如果換鞋墊後左鞋還是太短，就改試長一個尺寸的左鞋，先不要再改右鞋。按最後試穿結果分別記下左右鞋的鞋楦和鞋墊，不要把左腳較新的紀錄複製到兩欄。 如果這樣最適合舞者，左右鞋可以各用不同的搭配下訂。
